categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Fullhan Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, development, and sales of visual chips centered on video processing. Its main business segments include professional video processing, smart IoT (Internet of Things), and smart automotive video chips. The company also provides related technical development and IC design services, serving global leading brand terminal products in these fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced integrated circuit design technologies focusing on video encoding, image signal processing (ISP), and neural network processors (NPU) for AI acceleration. It follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries. Key technologies include AI-enhanced ISP algorithms, multi-standard video codecs (including H.266), low-power design, and high integration SoC platforms tailored for various applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are professional video equipment manufacturers, smart IoT device makers, and automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. The company’s chips are used in products such as analog and network cameras, digital video recorders, AI glasses, smart home devices, and automotive driver monitoring and surround-view systems. Major end markets include security surveillance, consumer electronics, industrial applications, and automotive electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for over 90% of revenue. It is actively expanding overseas markets to diversify risk and tap into global demand, especially in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. Subsidiaries and branches are located in Shanghai, Chengdu, Jiangyin, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Fullhan Microelectronics is positioned upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless IC design company. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors. The company manages quality control and product specifications but does not own manufacturing fabs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in AI-enabled visual processing chips, high-performance edge computing SoCs, and automotive-grade video processing solutions. It emphasizes innovation in AI-ISP algorithms, neural network processors, multi-standard video codecs, and low-power designs. Strategic initiatives include expanding product coverage, enhancing integration, adapting to AI and large model computing trends, and strengthening global talent recruitment and management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of integrated circuit chips and related technical services. The company uses a combination of direct sales to major customers and distribution through authorized regional agents to reach a broad customer base. Revenue streams include product sales of video processing chips for professional, consumer, and automotive applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the visual chip design sector with a strong market position in professional video, smart IoT, and automotive video chips. Competitors in professional video chips include Novatek and StarFive; in smart IoT chips, Beijing Junzheng, Ankai Micro, and Guoke Micro; and in automotive video chips, Sony and NEXTCHIP. Shanghai Fullhan leverages its technological depth, product breadth, and customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.79 billion, a slight decrease of 1.76% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 257.65 million, up 2.04%. It sold about 160 million chips, a 13.89% increase in volume. The company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 3.88 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures reaching nearly RMB 350 million, representing 19.54% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Fullhan Microelectronics emphasizes high-performance, low-power, and highly integrated visual processing chips with advanced AI capabilities. Its proprietary AI-ISP technology significantly enhances image quality under low-light conditions with industry-leading noise reduction and dynamic range. The company offers comprehensive SoC solutions tailored to diverse application scenarios, supported by strong customer service and technical support, enabling customers to accelerate product development and market entry.
